## 1. Trip Overview & Financial Budget Framework

Executing a 1-week business trip from Shanghai (PVG/SHA) to Berlin (BER) requires balancing efficiency, comfort, and financial limits. With a capped budget of **¥30,000 RMB**, funds are strategically allocated to guarantee a premium experience: premium/efficient flights, 7 nights at a high-end central Berlin business chain hotel, comprehensive ground transport, and upscale business dining.

  * **Option 2 (via Munich):** Flight LH727 departing PVG at 23:35, arriving MUC at 06:10 (+1 day). Layover in MUC for 1h 50m. Connecting flight LH1930 departing MUC at 08:00, arriving BER at 09:05 on October 16. Total duration: 15h 30m.
